ApplicabilityClaim.description: Immutable attribution of an instantiated scientific claim.

basis.description: Fitted, recommended or validated region; none for unknown/unrestricted/union.

call.description: Distinguishes actual bound applications, including derived arguments.

coverage.description: Joint whole-interval application, only for a verified declared interval.

evidence.description: Evidence source; absent for an undeclared claim.

form.description: Form whose actual application demanded this evidence.

id.description: Absent exactly for undeclared evidence, which is unknown.

layer.description: Evidence layer, distinct from a mathematical domain.

owner.description: Declared scientific family or model owner.

owner_lineage.description:
Checked nominal owner and its entity-kind ancestors, in most-derived order.
Non-kind owners have only themselves; callers cannot author this witness.

reason.description: Explicit unknown reason, never a numerical predicate result.

records.description: Distinct scientific records selected by this application.

ApplicabilityInput.description: Numerical inputs are recorded in the lowering's canonical physical units.

quantity_type.description: Actual physical quantity type; values use its canonical unit.

value.description: Actual value at the demanded application; the wire retains explicit IEEE evidence.

ApplicabilityObservation.description: One typed observation, including alternative evidence which was not required.

admitted.description: Whether the low-level evidence gate admitted this required claim.

extrapolation_allowed.description: Whether leaving this particular claim's region was permitted.

inputs.description: Actual inputs of this claim application.

instance.description: Bound assembly instance, populated by the executing consumer.

permissions.description: Authorizing declarations that matched this claim's exact target.

required.description: This claim was required, rather than a nonwinning union alternative.

unknown_allowed.description: Both permissions remain independent even for a mixed dependency result.

ApplicabilityPermission.description: Authorization retains its declaration and scope, with fixed named targets.

allow_extrapolation.description: Independent permission for leaving a declared region.

allow_unknown.description: Independent permission for absence of evidence.

scope.description: Declaring lexical consumer scope, not the claim's owner.

target_kind.description: Named records or declared scientific families.

targets.description: Exact admitted target identities; inheritance never widens this set.

BoundaryDiagnosticBody.description: Stable structured cause shared by Rust and the public error projection.

applicability.description: Complete scientific evidence on demanded paths, including refused claims.

causes.description: Ordered retained cause envelopes, preserving repeated aggregate occurrences.

class.description: Machine-readable disposition; callers never parse the message.

code.description: Detailed semantic identity, authoritative over every coarse projection.

locations.description: Available source locations. Empty means unattributed, not a guessed source.

observations.description: Values observed while checking the contract.

rule.description: The violated named contract, not a replacement for source identities.

severity.description: Error, warning or information; a warning never makes a model invalid.

sources.description: All affected authored identities, in deterministic order.

stage.description: Operation boundary, such as selected admission or provider registration.

validity.description: The lineage of a rejected authored validity predicate; absent on every other finding.

FitResidualReport.description: Native residual-method evidence; final original assessment sets qualification separately.

failure.description: First original refusal, preserved through callback None and native return.

parameter_updates.description: Actual library parameter updates, bounded by original iteration controls.

qualification.description: Qualification from original finite quality/gradient, never native success alone.

stationarity.description: Maximum normalized original gradient component from the independent final point.

stopping.description: Actual algorithm criteria and finite allowances; absent for fixed evaluation.

termination.description: Literal library termination category and detail.

FitResidualTermination.description: Actual residual-native stopping reason, independent of original scientific qualification.

oneOf.description: Original callback refused; its typed cause is retained separately.
Nonfinite library arithmetic.
A profile pin fixes every remaining coordinate; the original source is evaluated directly.
Every requested weighted residual is zero.
Library residual/Jacobian orthogonality criterion.
Library relative objective or step stopping tests.

ftol.description: Relative objective-change stopping test was satisfied.

xtol.description: Relative parameter-step stopping test was satisfied.

oneOf.description: Further improvement was limited by machine precision.
Library finite evaluation allowance exhausted.
Library shape/parameter contract refused.

IntervalBound.description: One end of a confidence interval.

value.description: The end in the parameter's unit; absent when a profile chain stopped.

Observation.description: Evidence distinguishes absence, finite numerical/physical values and nonfinite failures.

oneOf.description: Evidence was not available.
A finite numerical observation (not necessarily a physical magnitude).
Explicitly tagged nonfinite numerical failure evidence.
Finite physical evidence bound to its complete immutable quantity contract.
Exact counts or native codes.
A checked predicate.
Native status or explanatory detail.
Ordered physical operand/free-index contracts, preserved structurally.

OperandContract.description: A complete registered quantity type plus its free-index obligations.

indices.description: Ordered bound-index, domain and entity-kind identities.

PhysicalObservation.description: Finite physical evidence bound to its complete immutable quantity contract.

ProfileChain.description: The chain of one free parameter toward one end.

actual_parallelism.description: Successfully started workers in this profile execution.

end.description: The end the chain moves toward.

estimate.description: The fit estimate of the parameter.

points.description: Every pinned fit, in solve order.

qualifiers.description: Limitations retained from the estimate and accepted pins through this interval end.

scheduling_failures.description: Worker start or environment failures for this execution, including partial starts.

worker_failure.description: Typed worker failure, separate from the scientific interval outcome.

ProfileFailure.description: A retained source failure. Clones share the same typed witness; presentation is derived.

applicability.description: Complete scientific evidence on demanded paths, including refused claims.

causes.description: Ordered retained cause envelopes, preserving repeated aggregate occurrences.

class.description: Machine-readable disposition; callers never parse the message.

code.description: Detailed semantic identity, authoritative over every coarse projection.

locations.description: Available source locations. Empty means unattributed, not a guessed source.

observations.description: Values observed while checking the contract.

rule.description: The violated named contract, not a replacement for source identities.

severity.description: Error, warning or information; a warning never makes a model invalid.

sources.description: All affected authored identities, in deterministic order.

stage.description: Operation boundary, such as selected admission or provider registration.

validity.description: The lineage of a rejected authored validity predicate; absent on every other finding.

ProfilePoint.description: One pinned fit of a profile chain.

accepted.description: Qualified stationary or better and feasible, and used by the chain.

callback_terminal_failure.description: The native callback owner latched a terminal failure, even for a trial-class cause.

detail.description: Why the pinned fit failed or was not used.

failures.description: Original typed cause; serialized through its owner's boundary diagnostic.

objective.description: The pinned fit's objective, half the weighted residual sum of squares.

qualification.description: The pinned fit's qualification, when the runner returned a report.

qualifiers.description: Applicability and closure limitations of this independently checked pin.

residual.description: Actual residual-native evidence for this pin; absent for a native NLP pin.

seed.description: The chain point whose solution seeded this fit; `None` for the fit estimate (PS-11).

termination.description: Actual native termination, when the runner returned a report.

value.description: The pinned parameter value, in the parameter's unit.

ProfileWorkerFailure.description: Infrastructure outcome of one chain; this never becomes a scientific trial rejection.

oneOf.description: The chain began and its worker unwound. It is never replayed.

A worker could not start or enter its execution environment; an unstarted
chain carries this outcome when no remaining worker completes it.
Entering the worker's native environment failed with an original typed cause.

ResidualLmCriteria.description:
Exact algorithm stopping criteria used by residual LM.
These relative/cosine values do not represent original physical stationarity.

relative_cost_change.description: Actual and predicted relative objective-reduction threshold (ftol).

version.description: Encoding of these distinct algorithm criteria.

ResidualLmStopping.description: Actual algorithm criteria and finite allowances for one executed LM invocation.

criteria.description: The actual distinct algorithm stopping criteria.

residual_evaluation_limit.description: Maximum residual callback calls, checked before evaluating the original model.

SourceLocationBody.description: Authored location attached by the owner that has the source map.

document.description: Actual parser document identity; absence cannot qualify byte offsets.

occurrence_position.description: Original position within that occurrence role.

occurrence_role.description: Compiler-supplied occurrence role, independent of a display name.

path.description: Definition or document path, never a backend-local node identifier.

revision.description: Immutable source interpretation context; absence is explicitly unattributed.

source.description: Original semantic occurrence or instance identity.

start.description: UTF-8 starting byte offset, when supplied by the parser/compiler.

ValidityLineage.description:
What a rejected authored validity predicate guards (ADR-0123 Outcome 4, Plan 23 H5): its
layer and the declaration stating it; for the form and data layers the form it belongs
to, the parameter sets whose values bound it and the form's declared arguments it
constrains; for the closure layer the model members its range bounds. A fixture's
expected validity failure is matched against this lineage, not against a rule text.

form.description:
The form: the function declaration whose evaluation was rejected; absent on the
closure layer.

layer.description:
The form layer (a function's own domain), the data layer (a declared envelope) or
the closure layer (an annotated range).

members.description: The model members a closure range bounds; empty on the form and data layers.

sets.description: The table rows or entities whose values bound the predicate, in order.

source.description:
The form itself, the relation or kind declaration declaring the envelope, or the
closure range's annotation.

variables.description: Positions of the constrained arguments among the form's declared arguments.

description: Whether profile intervals were requested, available, or withheld by native admission.

oneOf.description: No profile request was made.
Every chain, including worker failures and its actual parallelism.

chains.description: Every retained chain, including distinct worker failures.

oneOf.description: The native reason and retained diagnostic explanation.
